title: Standardizing Markdown Documentation for Technical Teams
business: Technical documentation teams managing cross-platform knowledge bases.
problem: Inconsistent rendering of documentation across different internal tools due to ambiguous Markdown parsing rules.
solution: Adopting the CommonMark specification ensures unambiguous parsing of structural elements like lists, headings, and block quotes, providing predictable output across all rendering engines.
steps: Audit existing documentation for non-standard syntax extensions.
Integrate the spec_tests.py script into the CI/CD pipeline to validate document structure.
Configure internal parsers to align with CommonMark precedence rules for block and inline elements.
Standardize on explicit indentation for nested lists to avoid ambiguity.
outcome: Unified document rendering across all internal platforms, reducing developer confusion and support tickets.
limitation: The CommonMark spec does not mandate how non-ASCII characters in URLs are percent-encoded, which can lead to minor cross-platform link resolution differences; verify by testing specific URL character sets in target environments.
